comment: Validates the COMPLETE secure_suspend → http_request chain end-to-end. The handles `<sv_demo_user>` and `<sv_demo_password>` are placed directly in the http_request config (this is exactly the pattern the canvas-builder meta-agent will produce: it gets handles from ask_secret and pastes them into the body field of the apiCall config it creates). At execution time, inject_secrets replaces the handles with real values just before the wire call. httpbin.org/post echoes the body, proving the real values reached the wire. `secure: true` re-hashes the response so the echoed values appear as <value_N> in the node output.
